sentences.text:
1 preferred present revision.
3. Learned counsel for revisionist contended that revisionist has been convicted for want of license though it could not be shown that he was selling the milk, but it is evident from record that Revisionist possessed 25 litres of Milk in a container and no valid explanation could be offered by Revisionist for the same.
Both Courts below have recorded concurrent findings that the Milk was either for sale or storage and in both the circumstances license was required.

4. In absence of any evidence to show that revisionist had valid license either to purchase or storage of such huge quantity of milk, it cannot be said that conviction of revisionist under Section 7 (iii)
read with Rule 50 and Section 16 (1) (a) (iii) of Act, 1954, is bad or erroneous.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
6. The accused-revisionist, Hari Ram Shukla is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out the sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be prepared within two months.
7. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
